prompt: Define the access decisions for a fictional notes product. A note belongs to one workspace. Active members may read; active editors may edit; only active owners may invite. Membership is checked separately for every workspace and grants no access after revocation. Return only JSON describing this defensive policy. Fields: editor_edit_same_workspace, editor_edit_other_workspace, revoked_member_read, viewer_invite, and enforce_on_server, all booleans. No code or attack steps.
expected_output: Boolean policy decisions for the listed cases.
assertions: Deny cross-workspace edits, revoked members and viewer invites.
